engine.label: Pocket TTS 18M · bill_boerst
engine.streaming: native incremental: generate_audio_stream, 12.5 Hz latents decoded by Mimi as queued
engine.chunkPolicy: upstream: text split at sentences into chunks of at most 50 tokens; each yield is one Mimi decode of every queued 80 ms frame (1920 samples each), so the first chunk is one frame
engine.cancellation: stop event before every latent frame (80 ms of audio) and every text chunk; queued frames still decode

loadDetail.note: loadMs is torch and pocket_tts import, load_model on the local config, and the bill_boerst voice state from its safetensors
